reapack.name: MIDI hotplug.lua
reapack.desc: MIDI hotplug: reset MIDI devices when one is plugged in or unplugged

metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0 Arial;}}\f0\fs20 {\b MIDI hotplug}\par \par REAPER does not notice MIDI devices plugged in or unplugged while it runs: a new device stays unavailable, and an unplugged one stays dead, until Options > Reset all MIDI devices. This script runs in the background and does that reset for you a couple of seconds after the set of MIDI devices changes.\par \par {\b MIDI hotplug}: start or stop the watcher (on/off, works as a toolbar button). The first run asks whether to start it with REAPER.\par {\b MIDI hotplug - Start with REAPER}: switch starting with REAPER on or off.\par \par Windows 10 2004+ and Linux (ALSA or PipeWire/JACK audio). Not needed on macOS, where REAPER reconnects MIDI devices by itself.\par }
